announcements.headline: Signing of Coppa Club, Greenwich Peninsula
announcements.insight: Coppa Collective plc has signed an agreement at Greenwich Peninsula. This follows a related party transaction in July and a full year trading update in October.

announcements.headline: Full Year Trading Update
announcements.insight: Coppa Collective plc issues a full year trading update. This follows a July 2026 related party transaction, suggesting ongoing corporate activity.

announcements.headline: Related Party Transaction
announcements.insight: Coppa Collective plc has announced a related party transaction. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on the nature and implications of this deal.
